PhonePe.summary: UPI transfers and payments to people and merchants.

sources.title: PhonePe UPI terms
sources.supports: UPI service, registration and supported bank/payment accounts.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: PhonePe facilitates person-to-person transfers and payments to online and offline merchants.

claims.label: Eligibility — PhonePe platform
claims.text: General terms require users to be 18 or older and legally able to enter an agreement.

claims.label: Eligibility — bank/payment-account UPI
claims.text: Registration requires a PhonePe account and your own bank or payment account linked to an active mobile number. The terms also describe NRI registration with supported overseas numbers.

Google Pay.summary: Google’s payments app, with a dedicated experience for users aged 13–18.

sources.title: Google Pay India terms
sources.supports: Age, guardian permission and registration requirements.

sources.title: Add a bank account with a debit card or Aadhaar

claims.label: Product and intended users
claims.text: Supports payments to people, stores and billers; a separate experience serves users aged 13–18. This supports a younger-user tag without assuming that most users are young.

claims.label: Eligibility — age
claims.text: India terms set a minimum age of 13. Users under 18 need a parent or legal guardian’s permission. The teen help page requires Indian residence and a +91 mobile number.

claims.label: Eligibility — bank linking
claims.text: The help page describes verification using debit-card details or Aadhaar. The bank account must be linked to the mobile number used on Google Pay.

Paytm.summary: UPI payments provided through partner PSP banks.

sources.title: Paytm UPI terms
sources.supports: UPI service, payment accounts and PSP bank role.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Paytm acts as a third-party app provider for UPI through partner PSP banks.

claims.label: Eligibility — Paytm platform
claims.text: The current general terms require users to be at least 18 and legally able to enter an agreement. Additional terms can apply to specific services.

unknowns: A complete UPI-specific onboarding checklist and the eligibility of each separate financial product were not verified. An older minor-access FAQ returned HTTP 410 and is not treated as current evidence.

super.money.summary: UPI cashback app with bank-issued co-branded credit-card products.

sources.title: Co-branded card partners
sources.supports: Different card issuers and FD-backed products.

claims.label: Product and intended users
claims.text: Offers UPI payments and card products with rewards. Its partner page lists Axis Bank, Utkarsh Small Finance Bank and Kotak Mahindra Bank products.

claims.label: Eligibility — UPI
claims.text: UPI terms require authority to operate the linked bank account and keeping the mobile number updated with that bank.

claims.label: Eligibility — secured cards
claims.text: The partner page identifies FD-backed Utkarsh and Kotak products. That collateral requirement is specific to those products, not all super.money UPI users.

unknowns: An app-wide minimum age and complete card approval criteria were not verified in the cited pages.

sources.title: BHIM frequently asked questions
sources.supports: Product purpose and bank-account registration instructions.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: BHIM sends and receives money using UPI. Its FAQ describes registration and UPI PIN setup.

claims.label: Eligibility — bank-account registration
claims.text: The FAQ requires a smartphone, a bank account and a mobile number registered with the bank. It describes setting a UPI PIN with the account’s debit-card details.

unknowns: A minimum age was not verified. The cited FAQ does not establish every alternative payment or onboarding mode.

FamApp by Trio.summary: UPI and card payments with both linked-bank and FamX wallet modes.

sources.title: FamApp product page
sources.supports: Bank and wallet payments and next-generation positioning.

claims.label: Product and intended users
claims.text: FamApp describes UPI and card payments for the next generation, with FamX wallet and linked-bank payment modes.

unknowns: Current numerical age, guardian-consent and KYC requirements for the wallet and bank-linking modes were not verified. An indexed official test-path FAQ was inaccessible and is not used as current eligibility evidence.

WhatsApp.summary: UPI payments within WhatsApp in India.

sources.title: WhatsApp India payments terms
sources.supports: UPI product, minimum age and matching mobile/bank requirements.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: WhatsApp India facilitates payments through PSP banks using UPI within WhatsApp.

claims.label: Eligibility — WhatsApp Pay
claims.text: Payments terms require age 18+, a phone number with India’s country code and an account at a UPI-supporting bank. The WhatsApp number must match the bank-linked number. Users must own the bank account.

CRED.summary: Credit-card bill management and rewards with membership eligibility checks.

sources.title: About CRED
sources.supports: Credit-card use case and credit-score-based membership.

sources.title: CRED terms and eligibility
sources.supports: Service-specific credit thresholds and card underwriting.

claims.label: Product and intended users
claims.text: CRED describes a membership platform for managing credit cards and rewarding timely card-bill payments. This supports a card-user tag, not an income or wealth claim.

claims.label: Eligibility — membership
claims.text: CRED terms require legal capacity and permission to obtain credit information. CRED can set or change the credit-score threshold for access to services; this page does not promise membership at a fixed score.

claims.label: Eligibility — co-branded card
claims.text: The CRED–IndusInd RuPay card section requires age 18+, Indian residence, existing CRED app use and the bank’s creditworthiness criteria. These are card rules, not a blanket UPI requirement.

unknowns: A universal age or fixed credit-score threshold applying to every CRED feature was not established.

Amazon Pay.summary: Payments inside Amazon, including bank-linked UPI and a separate wallet.

sources.title: Amazon Pay feature guide
sources.supports: Distinguishes wallet from bank-linked UPI, bill payments and shopping.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: Amazon distinguishes its wallet from Amazon Pay UPI, which links a bank account through the Amazon app for shopping and payments.

claims.label: Eligibility — UPI setup
claims.text: The guide describes linking a bank account through Amazon’s app. It does not publish a complete age, residency or account-type eligibility checklist.

unknowns: Minimum age, supported account types and complete current onboarding requirements were not verified.

MobiKwik.summary: Payments platform with UPI and a prepaid wallet.

sources.title: MobiKwik terms and conditions
sources.supports: Wallet eligibility and the distinct UPI service.

claims.label: Product
claims.text: MobiKwik’s terms cover its wallet and identify a separate UPI service through PSP banks.

claims.label: Eligibility — prepaid wallet
claims.text: The PPI section requires users to confirm age 18+ and consent to collection of identity documents for regulatory compliance. This wallet rule is not assumed to cover every other product.

unknowns: A complete UPI-specific eligibility checklist was not verified.
